models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Antenna 2 for Radio (R93) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Antenna 2 for Radio (R93)
technicalNotes: On Radio/Navigation Upgrades/Retrofits the 2nd Antenna is often missing from the Factory installation. Instead of Retrofitting the whole Factory Antenna System, the most efficient way is to retrofit a 3rd party Window Antenna like the Blaupunkt Autofun.
